activities.name: Northern Lights Gaming Community. Created and manage an online gaming community
activities.description: Northern Lights Gaming Community. Created and manage an online gaming community connecting 200+ isolated teens across Northwest Territories. Organize weekly virtual tournaments, moderate discord channels, and coordinate mental health support resources. Grew membership by 150% in two years.

activities.description: Youth Swim Academy. Provide swimming instruction to 30+ students weekly, including specialized lessons for children with disabilities. Developed modified teaching techniques for differently-abled learners. Certified in Water Safety Instruction and First Aid.

activities.name: Frost & Finance Student Initiative. Founded peer-led financial literacy program
activities.description: Frost & Finance Student Initiative. Founded peer-led financial literacy program combining accounting principles with real-world applications. Led bi-weekly workshops for 25 high school students, teaching budgeting, basic accounting, and investment strategies adapted for Northern Canadian context.

activities.name: Arctic Threads Collective. Established student-run sewing group creating winter
activities.description: Arctic Threads Collective. Established student-run sewing group creating winter clothing for local homeless shelter. Coordinated 15 members, organized monthly workshops, and produced 100+ items annually. Secured fabric donations from local businesses to maintain cost-effectiveness.

activities.name: Territorial Student Mental Health Alliance. Trained and certified peer counselor
activities.description: Territorial Student Mental Health Alliance. Trained and certified peer counselor supporting students with anxiety and stress management. Facilitated weekly support groups reaching 40+ students. Developed innovative coping strategies combining physical activity and mindfulness techniques.

activities.description: Yellowknife Food Bank Youth Division. Lead weekly baking program producing fresh bread and pastries for local food bank. Manage team of 8 volunteers, coordinate ingredient donations, and implement cost-effective recipes. Increased weekly output from 50 to 200 servings.
